description: Began the riddle, stopped before the answer, and showed the loaf against the notch.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Set the soft supper, stopped the riddle, and said evening prayer was already said at the table.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Laid his tail across the corner and stayed.
name: Gib

description: Finished the sound of the riddle in his own tongue and refused to translate it.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Sat ahead, turned away, and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Preached. None of it was kept.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Sat at the board and did not move the bowl for the sake of the tail.
name: William Shakespeare
